title: Financial Tracking
description: Period cost record for a project: planned vs. committed vs. actual, with earned-value fields and links to the purchase orders driving committed spend.

period.description: Reporting period in YYYY-MM (monthly) or YYYY-Qn (quarterly) form.

plannedCost.description: Budgeted cost of work scheduled for the period (PV).

committedCost.description: Cost obligated via issued purchase orders, not yet paid.

actualCost.description: Cost actually incurred in the period (AC).

forecastAtCompletion.description: Estimate at completion (EAC) for the project.

costVariance.description: EV - AC. May be negative (over budget).

linkedPurchaseOrderIds.description: POs contributing to committed/actual cost. FK -> procurement-plan/purchase-order.poId.
